gaps.sentence: There isn't ___ milk left in the fridge.
gaps.explanation: In negative sentences use 'any' with uncountable nouns.

gaps.sentence: He kept ___ even though everyone had left.
We stopped ___ some photos on the way.
gaps.explanation: 'stop to do' = pause in order to do something.

gaps.sentence: It was ___ a good film that we saw it twice.
Unless it ___ , the match will go ahead.
gaps.explanation: 'unless' = if…not; present simple after time/condition words.

gaps.sentence: It's not worth ___ about the delay now.
We'll start the meeting ___ everyone arrives.
gaps.explanation: 'when/once/until' — here 'when everyone arrives' starts the event.
